scripts.build: pnpm exec tsx -e "import * as React from 'react'; import { render } from '@react-email/render'; import Portal2ProposalEmail from './Portal2ProposalEmail.tsx'; render(React.createElement(Portal2ProposalEmail, {})).then(() => console.log('Rendered proposal email'), (error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; })"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --jsx react-jsx --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck Portal2ProposalEmail.tsx
